info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Merchandising Loan API
info.description: The Merchandising Loan API enables businesses to facilitate loans specifically designed for acquiring merchandise. This endpoint allows users to submit loan applications, which can be efficiently processed to help finance inventory purchases. Typical consumers include retailers and wholesale distributors seeking to optimize their cash flow. By leveraging this API, businesses can enhance their operational efficiency and make data-driven decisions regarding their merchandising strategies.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to initiate the process of creating a merchandising loan, providing necessary details for the loan application.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate a merchandising loan. It requires a JSON formatted payload that contains the necessary parameters for processing the loan transaction.
